pillars.label: AI-for-RAN
pillars.text: AI improves the RAN: signal processing, scheduling, and control.

pillars.label: AI-and-RAN
pillars.text: AI and RAN workloads share the same accelerated compute.

pillars.label: AI-on-RAN
pillars.text: The RAN becomes a platform for AI services at the edge.

papers.title: ARCHES: Adaptive Real-Time Switching of AI Models for the RAN
papers.summary: Switches between AI-based and conventional signal processing experts inside a GPU-accelerated PHY, running AI only when it pays off.
facts: +5.32% / +7.23% median uplink PHY throughput (good / poor channels)
~140 µs control loop, sub-microsecond decisions
15.8 W less GPU power (−9.6%), 17 points lower GPU utilization

papers.title: Programmable and GPU-Accelerated Edge Inference for Real-Time ISAC on NVIDIA Aerial Testbed
papers.summary: Feeds PHY data from a GPU-accelerated gNB to custom AI logic, turning the base station into a real-time sensing platform.
facts: 84 µs framework latency per slot
123 µs control loop with TensorRT inference
73 cm mean localization error, 79% of predictions within 1 m
241 µs live execution for cuSense

papers.title: Improving 5G AI-RAN MCS Selection by Predicting Retransmissions
papers.summary: A dApp that predicts retransmissions from recent HARQ history and corrects the MCS chosen by existing link adaptation, without replacing it.
facts: 82.9% prediction accuracy; high-confidence corrections right 94.2% of the time
5.5 µs inference latency
Up to 71.5% more goodput and 71.8% fewer retransmissions, without retraining

papers.title: AgentRAN: An Agentic AI Architecture for Autonomous Control of Open 6G Networks
papers.summary: LLM-powered agents turn natural language intents into a self-organizing hierarchy of control loops, validated in live 5G experiments.
facts: Control loops from sub-millisecond to minutes
From cell to network-wide, PHY/MAC to RRC
AI-RAN Factory generates improved agents from operational data

papers.title: ALLSTaR: Automated LLM-Driven Scheduler Generation and Testing for Intent-Based RAN
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (to appear)
papers.summary: Generates working scheduler code from the research literature with OCR and LLMs, then tests it over the air.
facts: 18 schedulers synthesized from papers
Largest-scale over-the-air comparison of schedulers

papers.title: MAC-Gyver: Open, Programmable, Scheduling for AI-RAN 6G Systems
papers.summary: An open-source framework for scheduling applications that run inside the OpenAirInterface scheduler, over the air or in a PHY-less emulator.
facts: mac-emu runs up to 90 users on one host at real-time slot pace
A proactive uplink scheduler roughly halves median round-trip latency

papers.title: AutoRAN: Automated and Zero-Touch Open RAN Systems
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (to appear)
papers.summary: Language models translate intents into infrastructure-as-code that deploys O-RAN stacks on heterogeneous CPU/GPU clusters.
facts: End-to-end private 5G network deployed in under 60 s
1.6 Gbps throughput, on par with non-cloud deployments

papers.title: X5G: An Open, Programmable, Multi-vendor, End-to-end, Private 5G O-RAN Testbed with NVIDIA ARC and OpenAirInterface
papers.summary: The first 8-node network integrating NVIDIA Aerial ARC-OTA, OpenAirInterface, and a near-real-time RIC, with a GPU-accelerated PHY.
facts: 8-node network
>1.65 Gbps downlink, 143 Mbps uplink per cell
Up to 25 emulated UEs

papers.title: Beyond Connectivity: An Open Architecture for AI-RAN Convergence in 6G
papers.summary: A converged O-RAN and AI-RAN architecture: an AI-RAN Orchestrator extending the SMO, and AI-RAN sites for distributed edge AI.
facts: One orchestrator for telecom and AI workloads
Open, standardized interfaces and multi-vendor interoperability

papers.title: A Techno-Economic Framework for Cost Modeling and Revenue Opportunities in Open and Programmable AI-RAN
papers.summary: Models the costs of AI-RAN deployments and the revenue operators can earn by running AI workloads on RAN infrastructure.
facts: Cost modeling and revenue opportunities for operators
